summary: This 6-K filing by Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL), a Brazilian electric utility, announces an amendment and renewal of its existing share buyback program. The Board of Directors approved an increase in authorized repurchase capacity to up to 285,506,846 additional common shares (10% of outstanding), a renewal of the program term to November 21, 2027, and the continuation of treasury share holdings for cancellation, resale, or incentive plans. Acquisitions will occur on B3 at market prices through specified brokers, and funding is limited to available profits and reserves without affecting dividends. There are no stated price targets, premiums, or unusual structural conditions; this is a routine capital management filing and not a special situation.
